info.title: Access hosted Frontend API
info.description: The realm-scoped routes of the hosted pages and embedded components (TN-133), served under the realm's host and under /realms/{slug}. A planned route answers 501 not-yet-served.

post.summary: Starts a flow; its kind is login unless the body names another.

get.summary: The flow's current step.

post.summary: Submits one method of the current step.
Starts a step-up for an exact action and reason (X29).
What a sign-in link would do, before it is confirmed.
Confirms a sign-in link on the device that asked for it.

get.summary: This device's sign-in.
Where the account is signed in.

post.summary: Signs out on this device.
Signs out on every device; delegations remain.
Starts adding an authenticator app.
Confirms an authenticator app with its first code.
Makes new recovery codes, shown once.
The owner's password hash and authenticator app seeds, after a fresh step-up (TN-86).
Records the owner's "I saved them" for the newest recovery codes (TN-59).
Starts adding a passkey.
Finishes adding a passkey.

get.summary: The person's channel and topic preferences.
The documents the person accepted and those awaiting acceptance.

post.summary: Accepts one version of a document.

get.summary: The account's security history, 90 days, address prefixes only.
Whether the account is scheduled for deletion, and when.

delete.summary: Cancels a scheduled deletion inside its window.

get.summary: The person's export and deletion requests.

post.summary: Asks for the person's export: idp.account.export (OP-153 m.3 (cc)).
Opens a guest sign-in for a client that allows guests (OP-153 m.3 (k)).
Starts changing the e-mail address after a step-up (OP-153 m.3 (i)).
Confirms the new address with its out-of-band code.
Starts a recovery attempt; the answer is the same whether or not an account exists (OP-153 m.3 (d)).

get.summary: A recovery attempt's state.

post.summary: Submits one proof to a recovery attempt.
Extends the attempt's recovery contact codes once by 24 hours (OP-153 m.3 (d)).
Opens the credential-only sign-in of a reset intent (TN-61).

get.summary: The account's recovery contacts, at most three.

post.summary: Makes a cross-device link code, never sent by e-mail (OP-153 m.3 (d)).

get.summary: An invitation's organization and role, as text; a scanner's GET does not consume it.

post.summary: Accepts an invitation (OP-153 m.3 (o)).

get.summary: The organizations the person belongs to.

post.summary: Creates an organization: party_register and idp.org.create (OP-153 m.3 (b)).

get.summary: Home realm discovery by organization id (TN-3, TN-98): the target to confirm, only when the organization turned it on and holds a verified domain; the realm's sign-in policy still decides.

post.summary: Asks an organization's administrators for access.

get.summary: The open ownership handovers the person receives or, as an owner, may cancel (TN-91).

post.summary: The recipient's own contribution to an ownership handover: the ExerciseID of its accept_root contribute Exercise; it still waits for its delay and the owner's signed completion (TN-91, L0-META-20).

delete.summary: Cancels an open ownership handover: any owner or the recipient, until it commits; the record is kept (TN-91).

post.summary: A ward asks its guardian for consent to what the purpose digest names; the guardian is told through Relay and the request lapses after 72 hours. Silence is not consent (E53, E47).

get.summary: What a consent answers now, to its ward or guardian: allow, deny or require_action (E47).

post.summary: The guardian approves or declines once, before the request lapses (E53, E47).

get.summary: Starts sign-in with a social provider (OP-153 m.3 (l)).
The provider's redirect back; checked in the back end.
The account's linked sign-ins.

post.summary: Links another sign-in after re-authentication (OP-153 m.3 (m)).

delete.summary: Ends a linked sign-in; the record is kept.

post.summary: Combines two re-authenticated accounts, irreversibly (OP-153 m.3 (m)).

get.summary: The apps the person shares claims with (OP-153 m.3 (z)).

post.summary: Shares the claims a waiting third-party request asks for (OP-153 m.3 (z)).

delete.summary: Stops sharing claims with an app.

post.summary: What a waiting third-party request asks the person to share (OP-153 m.3 (z)).
The S1 draft a waiting third-party request's typed bounds open (§8.17.4.3, X27).

get.summary: This realm's halves of the account's cross-realm bindings (§12.1.3).

post.summary: Offers to bind the account to one in another realm, after re-authentication (§12.1.3, TN-65).
Commits this realm's half with the other realm's offer token (§12.1.3).
Commits the offering realm's half with the accepting realm's token (§12.1.3).
Ends another device's sign-in; names the device Instance whose instance.terminate the page then signs (OP-153 m.3 (y)).
Ties this sign-in to the device (DBSC, OP-153 m.3 (y)).
Refreshes a device-tied sign-in.
Receives CSP reports, 100 a minute per realm (OP-153 m.3 (t)).

get.summary: The realm's branding record as the hosted pages draw it: name and logo URL (TN-106, OP-153 m.3 (t)).
The realm's own texts for unprotected message keys, by locale and key, which the hosted pages draw in place of Access's (X35, OP-153 m.22 (k)).

post.summary: The person chose not to share: the waiting request goes back to the app with access_denied (X-L8).

get.summary: The account's sign-in methods for S11: password, passkeys, authenticator apps, recovery codes (TN-99, OP-148).

delete.summary: Removes a sign-in method after a recent re-authentication; never the last one (TN-68).

put.summary: Sets or changes the password after a recent re-authentication; other sign-ins end (TN-50).

get.summary: The RFC 8628 verification page, a trusted surface of its own: the person enters the code a device shows (OP-154 m.3 (p)).

post.summary: What a user code asks for: the client's name, the scope, and the IP prefix and country the request came from; five wrong codes wait 15 minutes (OP-154 m.3 (p)).
Approves or declines a user code with the person's AAS; the token it releases is DPoP-bound (OP-154 m.3 (p)).

get.summary: The person's agents (those they sponsor and those that used their accounts) and their connected accounts: name, kind, status, sponsor, last use; never a token or authority (OP-154 m.3 (e), (t)).
The person's connected accounts for agents, each with its upstream, scopes and state; never a token (OP-154 m.3 (t)).

post.summary: Starts connecting an upstream account after the person's AAS for that client (AS-M15, OP-154 m.3 (t)).

get.summary: One connected account: upstream, scopes, state (`active` or `needs_reconnect`); never a token.

delete.summary: Disconnects an account: the TokenSet ends and is revoked upstream where it can be; nothing is deleted (OP-73).

post.summary: Releases an upstream token only for an allowed Exercise whose PEP is the calling registered executor Instance, once per step, expiring by the horizon (G59, EI-26, OP-154 m.3 (t)).

get.summary: The Web Bot Auth key directory: the Ed25519 keys bound to live agent Instances; revoking an Instance removes its key (RFC 9421, OP-154 m.3 (u)).

post.summary: What the consent screen of a client the realm did not register shows: hostnames, the client's own claims, the resource, the scopes, the grant.issue the person's device Instance signs, and the CSRF token (§11.6, AS-M14, OP-154 m.3 (k)).
Keeps the consent record once the named Exercise is the person's own allowed grant.issue, then sends the browser back to the request (EI-18, P58).
The person declined: the waiting request goes back to the client with access_denied and nothing is kept (X-L8).

get.summary: The did:web document of a person or agent: verification keys and service endpoints; an identifier, never authority (OP-154 m.3 (aa)).

post.summary: A workload's key opens its own Instance of its agent with a self-signed instance_create; it stands only on the realm issuer's identity_binding_workload Claim about that key and still needs a Grant to act (OP-154 m.3 (d)).

Android key or TPM 2.0 evidence that an Instance's own key lives in hardware, for the challenge of that Instance and time; the realm issuer's attestation_runtime Claim bound to the Instance follows and grants nothing (§5.9, OP-154 m.3 (s)).

get.summary: SCIM: lists or filters Users; filter depth ≤ 32 and length ≤ 4 KB, at most 1000 results, pages of at most 200 with an HMAC'd RFC 9865 cursor (OP-155 m.3 (g)).

post.summary: SCIM: creates a User; the writes go through the account use cases and the client is a Claim source, never a grantor (IDP-23).

get.summary: SCIM: one User; a deleted one answers 404.

patch.summary: SCIM: PATCH of a User, atomic: one failed operation fails them all.

delete.summary: SCIM: soft-deletes a User with a tombstone; its id and externalId are never reused (INV-32, OP-73).

get.summary: SCIM: lists or filters Groups; filter depth ≤ 32 and length ≤ 4 KB, at most 1000 results, pages of at most 200 with an HMAC'd RFC 9865 cursor (OP-155 m.3 (g)).

post.summary: SCIM: creates a Group; the writes go through the account use cases and the client is a Claim source, never a grantor (IDP-23).

get.summary: SCIM: one Group; a deleted one answers 404.

patch.summary: SCIM: PATCH of a Group, atomic: one failed operation fails them all.

delete.summary: SCIM: soft-deletes a Group with a tombstone; its id and externalId are never reused (INV-32, OP-73).

get.summary: SCIM: lists or filters Devices; filter depth ≤ 32 and length ≤ 4 KB, at most 1000 results, pages of at most 200 with an HMAC'd RFC 9865 cursor (OP-155 m.3 (g)).

post.summary: SCIM: creates a Device; the writes go through the account use cases and the client is a Claim source, never a grantor (IDP-23).

get.summary: SCIM: one Device; a deleted one answers 404.

patch.summary: SCIM: PATCH of a Device, atomic: one failed operation fails them all.

delete.summary: SCIM: soft-deletes a Device with a tombstone; its id and externalId are never reused (INV-32, OP-73).

get.summary: SCIM: what the server supports; bulk.supported is false.
SCIM: the resource types, User, Group and Device.
SCIM: the schemas and extensions the server knows.

post.summary: SCIM Bulk is not offered and always answers 501 (OP-155 m.3 (g)).

get.summary: The SAML IdP metadata, signed with the realm's saml key (OP-155 m.3 (e)).
SAML SSO, HTTP-Redirect binding: access-server keeps the cookies and forwards the AuthnRequest to the SAML gateway with session_attest (OP-155 m.3 (c)).

post.summary: SAML SSO, HTTP-POST binding.

get.summary: IdP-initiated SSO to one service provider, only when its registration allows it; the assertion lives 2 minutes.
SAML single logout, HTTP-Redirect binding.

post.summary: SAML single logout, HTTP-POST binding.
SAML ECP (PAOS) with a per-application credential, never Basic authentication with the account's password (OP-155 m.3 (e)).

get.summary: WS-Federation passive requestor: wsignin1.0 and wsignout1.0 with a SAML 1.1 or 2.0 token per relying party (OP-155 m.3 (f)).

post.summary: WS-Federation passive requestor, POST form.

get.summary: The WS-Federation metadata document.
Starts sign-in at an enterprise upstream identity provider (OIDC or SAML); home realm discovery confirms the organization first when it is on (OP-155 m.3 (h)).
The OIDC upstream's redirect back; its subject key is the connection's own, sub or [tid, oid].

post.summary: The SAML upstream's assertion consumer service; an unsolicited Response is refused unless the connection opens it, and the raw assertion is sealed under the subject's DEK.

get.summary: Access's SP metadata for one SAML upstream connection.
What a one-use, 72-hour organization setup link opens: the organization and the wizard's steps (OP-155 m.3 (i)).

post.summary: Submits a wizard step: the identity provider's metadata or a test sign-in; enacting the connection stays the organization root's idp.upstream.register.

get.summary: The realm issuer's OpenID Federation entity configuration, signed with its federation key (OP-155 m.3 (j)).
Fetches a subordinate statement; served only in the intermediate or trust anchor role.
Lists subordinates; served only in the intermediate or trust anchor role.
Resolves an entity's metadata through its trust chain, at most 8 links; rate-limited.

post.summary: Whether a trust mark is still active.
Explicit OIDF client registration, when the realm opened it.
What a CIBA request asks: the client's name, the binding message and the scope, for the person's Approval Surface (OP-155 m.3 (l)).
Approves or declines a CIBA request with the person's AAS; the client learns it by poll or ping.

get.summary: Certificate, PIV and CAC sign-in on the mTLS listener: trust comes only from TLS that ends at access-server, never from a forwarded header (OP-155 m.3 (k), (m)).
The person's directory app passwords: application, created, last used; never the password (OP-155 m.3 (n)).

post.summary: Creates a directory app password for one application, shown once and kept as Argon2id.
Revokes a directory app password; nothing is deleted (OP-73).

get.summary: The OID4VCI issuer metadata of the person-attribute issuer (OP-155 m.3 (p)).

post.summary: Issues one person-attribute credential bound to the holder's device key or agent KeyBinding; other types are refused.
A fresh c_nonce for the holder's key proof.

get.summary: The credential types the person may add to a wallet.

post.summary: Makes a pre-authorized credential offer for one type, after the person's AAS.

Starts a push verification for the flow's second step: a 120 s single-use challenge sent by Relay to the person's approvers; the sign-in page shows the two-digit number from the RNG, which the push never carries. At most 3 pending per account in 10 minutes, none for 15 minutes after a refusal, none for an hour after 3 unanswered (OP-156 m.3 (d)).

The approver's answer: the push-challenge.cddl map {challenge, number, decision, device_key, pin_verified?} signed with its device key. A wrong number refuses; not_me makes a risk signal and a security notice. Push is AAL2 only and satisfies no Consequence Tier.

get.summary: The person's approver devices: name, registered, last used.

post.summary: Registers an approver's app-bound P-256 device key after a sign-in in the last 5 minutes, with the SEC18 cooldown; makes an authenticator_binding Claim (OP-156 m.3 (d)).
Retires an approver device; nothing is deleted (OP-73).

Makes an approver the app-controlled factor after a sign-in in the last 5 minutes: its key's Android key attestation or App Attest attestation for the challenge SHA-256("access/app-factor-attestation/v1" 0x00 issuer 0x00 thumbprint at), and under the TR payment profile the SMS activation code (MD-11, OP-156 m.3 (e)).
Texts the signed-in person a 6-digit activation code, 5 minutes, 3 tries, never to a line whose SIM changed in the last 90 days; the only SMS use of the TR payment profile (OP-156 m.3 (f)).

get.summary: The realm's RFC 9578 issuer directory of first-contact token keys, the current 30-day key first and the previous one after it; public, as Relay and agents read it (E58, OP-156 m.3 (z)).

post.summary: Issues RFC 9578 type 2 first-contact tokens for blinded requests (first-contact.cddl), limited per identity; a token is anonymous and unlinkable and produces no authority (E58, OP-156 m.3 (z)).

Issues an OpenSSH user certificate for an ephemeral Ed25519 key as a projection.issue: principals, constraints and lifetime from the ssh.login Grant, at most 12 hours for a person and 1 hour for an agent, never past the horizon (OP-156 m.3 (o)).

get.summary: The realm's OpenSSH key revocation list.
The realm's SSH user CA public key in authorized_keys form, for TrustedUserCAKeys.

post.summary: A registered Linux host's NSS snapshot for the daemon's cache: the principals of the live ssh.login Grants on its server group with their ids, served offline for at most 12 hours and never past the host's horizon; the host is named by its client certificate (OP-156 m.3 (p)).

A Linux console sign-in for the person whose DPoP-bound access token the host polled for: allowed when a live ssh.login Grant on the host's server group names the user; the person's device-bound security keys come back for an offline sign-in within 8 hours.
A sudo step-up, CT2 by default: a phishing-resistant authenticator; a push alone is not enough and nothing is served offline.

get.summary: The person's cloud key permissions for One: purpose, classes, until, TEE measurement; the record holds no key or data (OP-156 m.3 (w)).

post.summary: Grants One's cloud key permission as the device Instance's one.cloud_key.grant Exercise: purpose, classes, at most 24 hours, the TEE measurement and the Mandate that covers acting while the person is away.
Revokes a cloud key permission: one.cloud_key.revoke; the TEE copies must be destroyed before the work goes on.

get.summary: The person's handles: each a Suiss subdomain or a domain they own, pending until both directions agree, shown only once verified.

post.summary: Claims a handle after a sign-in in the last 5 minutes: a Suiss subdomain is verified at once, a domain of the person's own once its host answers /.well-known/access-handle with the DID. A handle is never handed to anyone else.
Asks the handle's host for /.well-known/access-handle; verified when it names the person's DID.
Retires a handle: it is no longer shown or listed in the DID document.

A support operator's request for support access: {subject, case, scope, minutes}. Access sends the person a support_access_request invitation; the operator never opens the person's trusted page, and only the person's own S1 grants access (OP-157 m.3 (f)).

get.summary: The person's open support access requests: who asks, for which case, which scope and for how long.

post.summary: The person declines a support access request; nothing is granted.

Uploads a support artifact for a case: HAR, JSON or a text log only, redacted on upload and sealed under its own key; an image or video answers 415 artifact-format-refused (idp.account.artifact_upload, OP-157 m.3 (g)).

get.summary: Reads one redacted support artifact under a separate idp.account.artifact_read Grant (CT2).
The person's support access: active and ended support Grants with operator, organization, case, scope and end time (U57, OP-157 m.3 (f)).

post.summary: The person revokes a support Grant; only that Grant and its cascade end, the person's sessions are untouched (OP-157 m.3 (c)).

put.summary: Turns Block support access on, a CT1 narrowing policy.set on the person's self-anchor, or off as the person's own Exercise (OP-157 m.3 (c)).

post.summary: Starts a CT1 batch approval of at most 10 requests of one requester and one action class, each shown and each with its own AAS; only in a realm that opened idp.realm.approval_batch (OP-157 m.3 (m)).
Finishes a batch approval with one assertion per item; any item outside the batch rules refuses the whole batch with approval-batch-invalid.

An approver device's in-notification CT1 answer (approval-inline.cddl): the device rebuilt the canonical render with the Kernel, compared render_digest and signed H(AAS) with its device key (surface_profile suiss-approver-sdk); only in a realm that opened idp.realm.approval_inline (OP-157 m.3 (m)).

get.summary: The MCP authorization server's consent step: redirects to the Approval Surface (/v1/approve); consent is an AAS bound to its grant_ref (OP-157 m.3 (l), §11.6).

post.summary: Answers 405: consent is never a form post outside the Approval Surface.

NotYetServed.description: The route is declared and not served yet (OP-153 m.4).
